title: What Is Jev? The AI Model That Doesn't Generate Text
description:
Learn more about New Frontier AI Models here → https://ibm.biz/~rGiO8LVz1

What if an AI model didn't need to generate text? Martin Keen explains Jev, a System 1 AI model that makes fast decisions using calibrated probabilities. Learn how Jev can complement LLMs for routing, classification, and AI guardrails.

 00:00 – Meet Jev and System 1 AI 
 01:29 – Compare Jev with LLMs and Reasoning Models 
 02:09 – See What Jev Is Built to Decide 
 04:04 – Understand How Jev Returns Probabilities 
 06:52 – Learn How AI Models Calibrate Confidence 
 09:18 – Train Jev with Calibrated Decisions 
 10:36 – Turn Jev Probabilities Into Software Decisions 
 12:24 – Use Jev for AI Guardrails 
 12:56 – Combine Jev with LLM Workflows 
 14:03 – Explore Where System 1 AI Could Go Next

AI news moves fast. Sign up for a monthly newsletter for AI updates from IBM → https://ibm.biz/~pW19rmUKV
